decisions: Titles keep structure '<Title> [U.C.xxxx]\n\n<Name> Story - STAGE n'; leading full-width padding dropped for re-centring; character names use glossary en_short.
rec1 lines (engage X) = 'Engage <faction> MS forces'; 'MS' used instead of 'mobile suit' throughout so lines stay near the Japanese width; butai = 'forces'.
rec2 victory conditions are terse imperatives 'Destroy <unit>' with no article (so 'Destroy The-O' reads cleanly).
rec3 defeat conditions are phrased as events ('Your unit is destroyed'); the Japanese list comma is rendered 'or'.
Stage titles follow the source anime episode titles where one exists; official English episode titles were not verified against a source (see uncertain).
uncertain: S00206/S00212: 08th MS Team title 'Nessa Sensen' - chose 'Desert Front Line'; official English title unverified.
S00209/S00214: 'Furueru Yama' - chose 'The Trembling Mountain' (believed to match 08th MS Team English title, unverified).
S00215: game-original title 'Alex destruction order' - chose 'Order to Destroy the Alex'.
S00223/S00228: 'Gekitotsu Sen'iki' - chose 'Clash Zone'; no matching episode title found.
S00226/S00230/S00232: 0083 ep.13 'Kakenukeru Arashi' - chose 'The Storm Rushes Through'; official English unverified.
S00240: 'Shiroi Yami wo Nukete' - chose 'Through the White Darkness'; unverified.
S00244/S00256: 'Eien no Four' - chose 'Four Forever'; 'Eternal Four' is the alternative.
S00245/S00259 'Uchuu no Uzu' -> 'Vortex of Space'; S00247/S00250/S00257/S00260 'Uchuu wo Kakeru' -> 'Racing Through Space'; both unverified Zeta episode titles.
S00264: 'Emary Sange' - chose 'The Fall of Emary' (given name only as in the Japanese; glossary en_short is the full 'Emary Ounce').
S00266: 'Senshi, Futatabi' - chose 'Warrior, Once Again'; singular/plural not settled by the Japanese.
S00195: 'Kyoufu! Kidou Big Zam' - chose literal 'Terror! The Mobile Big Zam'; official title may differ.
S00193/S00238: fixed-time engagement as a victory condition - chose 'Hold out for a set time'; S00238 comma read as 'or' (could be 'and').
S00229: chose 'Full Burnern' alone as in the Japanese; 'GP01 Full Burnern' would be clearer.
S00190: boken - chose generic 'mothership' (presumably White Base, not named in the Japanese).
